items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: all kinds of people used to come in there: Don Byas, Ray Nance, Paul Gonzalves

ctx.x: And you did the Monday nights at the Vanguard.

At the Vanguard. Every Monday. And you used to see — all kinds of people used to come in there: Don Byas, Ray Nance, Paul Gonzalves, a whole lot of people used to come in on Monday nights. It used to be a wonderful experience.
